import pandas as pd

# Load the capital dataset
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')

# Filter the data for the Younger Bronze Age (1100-500 BCE)
younger_bronze_age_df = capital_df[(capital_df['BCE'] >= 1100) & (capital_df['BCE'] <= 500)]

# Extract the Z values for the forms of capital
forms_of_capital = ['ZAxtSchwert', 'ZDolch', 'Zhausgr', 'ZCU_AU', 'Zamber', 'ZMonument', 'ZHort', 'ZSichel', 'ZBeil', 'ZMW', 'ZKeform', 'Zkeverz']

# Calculate the mean Z values for the beginning of the period (1100 BCE)
beginning_of_period_df = younger_bronze_age_df[younger_bronze_age_df['BCE'] == 1100]
beginning_of_period_means = beginning_of_period_df[forms_of_capital].mean()

# Calculate the mean Z values for the subsequent time horizons (1000 to 500 BCE)
subsequent_time_horizons_df = younger_bronze_age_df[younger_bronze_age_df['BCE'] != 1100]
subsequent_time_horizons_means = subsequent_time_horizons_df[forms_of_capital].mean()

beginning_of_period_means, subsequent_time_horizons_means
